annotations.title: Find models that fit a machine

description: Which tracked models run on a given GPU or Mac: measured GGUF weights + computed context cache + runtime overhead versus usable memory. Returns the best recommendation and every verdict (EXCELLENT/GOOD/TIGHT/OFFLOAD_REQUIRED/NOT_RECOMMENDED/UNKNOWN) with plain-language reasons, plus summary counts over all tracked models. For a short answer pass show "fits" (only models that run fully on the machine), a limit, or compact true (one row per model: name, quantization, verdict, total GB). Hardware ids are the ones list_hardware returns.

compact.description: One short row per model instead of the full arithmetic and reasons.

hardware.description: Hardware id or page slug, e.g. rtx-4090, mac-studio-m3-ultra-96gb.

limit.description: At most this many rows, best first.

show.description: Which verdicts to list: all (default), fits (runs fully on the machine), fits_or_spills (also those that spill into system RAM).

name: find_fit
